formula: A = Z + N   (nombre de masse = protons + neutrons)
sketch:
Observe: SVG nucleus rendered as A nucleons (Z protons red,
N = A−Z neutrons blue) packed in a circle. Student adjusts A and Z
sliders; the composition redraws. HUD reads symbol ᴬ_ZX by looking
up Z in a small periodic-table map (Z=1→H, 2→He, 6→C, 92→U…).
Experiment: 3 seeded target isotopes (e.g., ²³⁵U, ¹⁴C); student
sets (A, Z) to match. Evaluate: symbol HUD hidden; student sets
(A, Z) from symbol name alone. Wrinkle: isotope concept — same Z,
different A — surfaced by comparing two configurations side-by-side.
